entity_raw.definition_raw:
Diseases tend to have milder effects on you.

Prerequisite(s): Constitution 13.

Benefit(s): When you take damage or drain to your ability scores as the result of a disease, roll damage and drain to each ability score twice and take the lower result. You suffer any other effects of the disease as normal.
